desc: Analyze the operation dynamics and formally characterize the necessary red and blue route-operation sequences, including feasibility.
Validate that the minimum operation count is the shortest common supersequence length of the two required route sequences, accounting for repeated operations and precedence conflicts.
Develop an O(N log N) implementation: construct routes, compute LCS of distinct elements through LIS, and output the result.
Prove correctness (necessity, sufficiency, and optimality) and cover empty-color, balls at X, self-loop, and incompatible-cycle cases.
